_comment: Coverage policy. `minimum_total_percent` is the production-readiness TARGET (60%), NOT the currently enforced floor. The repo uses a monotonic ratchet: the EFFECTIVE gate is min(`minimum_total_percent`, baseline `total_percent` from config/coverage_baseline.json). While the baseline is below the target the effective floor equals the baseline, so a drop below current coverage fails but coverage is not yet required to be 60%. Raise the baseline (never the comment alone) as coverage climbs; see issues #2406 / #2474 / #3254.
